messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: real-time-latency-detector -> sudden p95/p99 breach for /v1/stream-gen (eu-central-1).
incident-bot: window=3m | p95: 280ms -> 1.9s | p99: 900ms -> 4.8s | streaming stalls +12% | open file: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/slo/streaming?window=3m
oncall-maya: paging SREs. i'm on it, starting quick triage. who's on runtime?
sre-raj: I'm handling. initial checks: any infra autoscaler events or recent deploys?
eng-platform-lee: nothing from CI in last hour. I see an autoscale event earlier that failed to add new pods to gw-euc1-pool because of node drain (~12:10). reverting drain now.
eng-runtime-sam: traces show long serialization delays inside the streaming proxy and a surge of small batches (~batch size 1) around 12:14-12:18. GPU utilization high on nodes 3 & 4 with queue latency stacking.
cs-omar: CS report: two customers reported degraded streaming (slow tokens then reconnect) — NeonChat and StudyMate. both had elevated client retries.
pm-inga: recommend we open a bridge if we need cross-team action. I'm ready to coordinate comms.
oncall-maya: opening bridge now: https://redwood.internal/bridge/3890123456 (bridge created). tagging runtime + platform + cs.
eng-platform-lee: autoscaler logs show failed join because of taint on new nodes, autoscaler backoff attempted 3x. manual untaint and join in progress.
sre-raj: immediate mitigations: 1) enable degraded-fallback-route for streaming -> route non-critical customers to v1-small (lower latency, lower memory). 2) throttle low-priority traffic at edge to protect core customers. I'm pushing both now.
eng-runtime-sam: running command to enable fallback: ```bash
curl -s -X POST https://internal-api/route-fallback -d '{"route":"/v1/stream-gen","variant":"v1-small","percent":30}'
```
eng-runtime-sam: and throttle rule: ```yaml
edge-rule:
  match: "/v1/stream-gen"
  actions:
    - type: rate_limit
      config: {requests_per_min: 9000}
```
sre-raj: monitoring effects. p95 dropping to 650ms after 60s, p99 at 1.8s. stall rate reduced by ~6%.
eng-platform-lee: node join completed at 12:22, new capacity available. autoscaler config issue logged: AUTOSCALE-3890. fixing taint logic to avoid backoffs.
cs-omar: NeonChat confirms improved experience and fewer reconnects. StudyMate still seeing occasional stalls but better than before.
eng-runtime-sam: found evidence of increased TCP retransmits between streaming proxy and GPU hosts at 12:13-12:17; possible transient network blip compounded by small batch amplification. attaching snippet: ```log
[12:14:02] proxy: retransmit detected to 10.2.3.4 seq=2345
[12:14:03] proxy: batch_size=1 -> dispatch
[12:14:05] gpu-queue: wait=412ms
```
sre-raj: plan: keep fallback in place for 15m, keep throttles for low-priority traffic, and let autoscaler replenish pool. if p99 < 1.2s and stalls < 3% for 10m, we'll unwind.
pm-inga: notify affected customers with short incident note and ETA for RCA. I'll draft message.
oncall-maya: assigning follow-ups: RC-389012 - investigate autoscaler taint/backoff (eng-platform-lee); RC-389013 - streaming proxy retransmit root cause (eng-runtime-sam); RC-389014 - evaluate routing rollback gating (sre-raj). deadline: initial RCA draft EOD.
eng-platform-lee: created AUTOSCALE-3890 and started a hotfix branch for taint handling. will submit PR and request expedited review.
eng-runtime-sam: running quick warmup to increase average batch size for hot prefixes to avoid tiny-batch amplification: ```python
# warm prefixes
post('/internal/warm', json={"prefixes":["/neon/","/study/"]})
```
sre-raj: p95 now ~420ms, p99 ~980ms at 12:28. still above baseline but trending to normal. stalls down to +3% over baseline.
cs-omar: customers acknowledged receiving the message and appreciate the quick mitigation. one asked for postmortem when ready.
oncall-maya: will keep bridge open for 30m. if metrics stable for 15 consecutive mins, we close paging and escalate to RCA. thanks all. :white_check_mark:
